title: Exact Formulas for Coprime Representations of Even Integers Avoiding a Prime
summary: Fix a prime $p \ge 5$ and define $g(2n,p)=\#\{(h,k)\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}^2 : h+k=2n,\; h\le k,\; \gcd(h,6p)=\gcd(k,6p)=1\}$. We derive explicit closed-form expressions for $g(2n,p)$ in terms of the canonical remainder operator $δ_k(x)=x-k\lfloor x/k\rfloor$, elementary step functions, and the minimal solutions of the congruences $6x \equiv -1 \pmod{p}$ and $6x \equiv -5 \pmod{p}$. A key ingredient is an explicit formula for the minimal solution of $δ_k(a_0 x)=b_0$ obtained via the Euclidean algorithm, which determines the excluded residue classes directly.
